title: Proposal: a better documentation
body:
Our current documentation is not good enough. It's mostly an API documentation.

There's no progressive learning of instantsearch.js. There's no custom use cases explained.

I propose to reorganize it like this:
- homepage
- guide
  - getting started
  - widgets
  - templates
  - url handling #1089 
  - modular builds
  - custom widgets
  - renderers
  - advanced use cases (targeting multiple indices #1056, jadopado like integration)
- widgets: one page per widget with API docs, advanced usage and live examples
- support
- contact
- github

If you have more ideas for the guide please add them, it's a draft.

We should also take the opportunity to move away from jenkins to middleman.
